intro f s [f_finite] [s_finite]
let f_set := ↑f
let s_set := ↑s
let f_seq_s := ⋃ g ∈ f_set, s_set → g
have : Finite ↑f_seq_s :=
  Finite.union (f_set.Finite) (λ g hg, 
    let g_set := ↑g,
    have : Finite ↑(s_set → g_set) := 
      Finite.Set.finite_image s_set (fun x => x) [s_finite],
    exact this)
